note: Measurement tool costs (docs/168 §9, Measurement cost rule PLAN.md 2026-10-24). Keys are the names tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts toolsOn() prints. msPerS = sim-thread ms per second the tool costs (null = not measured). timing: yes = allowed in timing runs with its cost taken off, after = light, allowed once its tool-cost.json job has a result, no = correctness runs only. costJob: the tools/harness/queues/tool-cost.json job(s) that measure it and the method (docs/168 §9). bundles: costs measured for several tools together; taken off when all members are on.

ProbeValues.how: counting stubs on many routing entries + 2 s poll thread (docs/108)

ProbeSnap.how: int3 snapshots, 16 hits per site per 30 s window (docs/94 §7, docs/109)

ProbeSnap.CallSites.how: passive call-site coverage (docs/133 §7): int3 on the 2115 vcallsites5.h sites, each self-disarming after 32 hits (256 for sites with >= 4 targets); cost early in a load then ~0, measured per run by cpTrapUs / cpLateUs; queue.ts turns it on for correctness jobs only

CrashForensics.how: [CrashForensics] (docs/157 §11.7): ring entry per P5 EA new/free and g_rpUse hold (~30-60 ns, off the sim thread except the cut) + two check-only guards (~5-10 ns per call: 0x5EE1E0 EASTL map erase, 0x7B0A00 array clear); no log line unless something is bad; ride-along in normal runs

CrashForensicsDraw.how: [CrashForensics] DrawGuards=1 OurEvents=1 (docs/186 §8): four check-only draw guards on the main thread (~1-2 ns per call: 2-4 compares behind a retargeted call or a 9-byte jmp; model part 0x6F6B5B, resource 0x6FA2DB, effect entry 0x71D562, shader binding 0x68FDA4; estimate <= ~2 ms/s at 50k bindings per frame, inferred) + our-events ring entry per destroy, deferral, decode, save step, refcount hold and route job (~30-60 ns, a few hundred per s); no log line unless something is bad; crash-hunt runs, no cost job yet

CrashForensicsEffect.how: [CrashForensics] EffectLog=1 (docs/186 §9): four vtable slot swaps on the Swarm render list (add 0xFFC850, remove 0xFFC854, gather 0xFFC290, draw 0xFFC260), one 64-byte ring entry per add / remove / gather (~50-80 ns: QPC + a 48-word stack scan), a counter read per draw call; first stale draw per gather walks the bucket lists (a few hundred nodes, ~us); estimate < 0.1 ms/s on the main thread, inferred; crash-hunt runs, no cost job yet

CrashForensicsObjRes.how: [CrashForensics] ObjResLog=1 (docs/186 §10): seven call-site retargets on the SceneModel model handle (unload 0x6F734E, load request 0x6F7331, full release 0x6DCC93/0x6DCD23/0x6DCD34/0x6DD353, node update 0x6F7B5D); node update = QPC + two guarded reads + a 24-byte table write (~40-60 ns) per scene model node update, a 64-byte ring entry only when it changes the LOD slot +8; unload / load / release ~50-80 ns each (QPC + 48-word stack scan). Node updates are thousands per second while lots stream (estimate 2-5k/s): ~0.1-0.3 ms/s on the main thread, inferred; crash-hunt runs, no cost job yet

M2LotDump.how: [RouteSnap] M2LotDump=1 / M2Box (docs/94 §24.8.4, p4lotdump.h, 0.36.50): no hook; on the P4/P5 worker only, after an M2/M3 compare or a compare whose start/goal is in M2Box, at most M2LotDumpMax (16) per session: one lot-table walk + the start lot's Q cells in the route box, clone and live (one +0x918 try, no wait), a few hundred us per dump, inferred; the sim thread pays only when the try lands while it waits for +0x918 (rare). Rides on RouteSnap Mode=1/2 correctness runs (already timing: no), no cost job

RouteSnap.audits.how: clone audits (AuditEvery / VerifyEvery / ReplayAudit*) compare whole snapshots
